# vergeio_tenant_node_devices (Data Source)

Lists the devices VergeOS has attached to one tenant node, including devices this configuration did not create. The list is ordered by name. `id` is the `machine_devices` key, and it is the value `terraform import vergeio_tenant_node_device.example <id>` accepts.

A device passed to the tenant is thick provisioned. The tenant owns it even when no VM inside the tenant is using it. [`vergeio_tenant_node_device`](../resources/tenant_node_device.html) keeps one of those devices in state. `device_count` is not on the device row, so this list does not report it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vergeio_tenant_node_devices" "node" {
  tenant_node_id = vergeio_tenant_node.example.id
}

output "device_names" {
  value = [for device in data.vergeio_tenant_node_devices.node.devices : device.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_node_id` (String) Key of the parent `vergeio_tenant_node`, the same value as `vergeio_tenant_node.id`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Devices VergeOS has attached to this tenant node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `created` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `description` (String) Device description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the device is enabled.
- `id` (String) `machine_devices` key. Import `vergeio_tenant_node_device` with this value.
- `machine` (Number) Machine key the device is attached to.
- `machine_type` (String) Machine kind stored on the device. A tenant node device is `tenant`.
- `modified` (Number) Last modification time as a Unix timestamp.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the tenant node can start without this device.
- `orderid` (Number) Device order, from 0 through 64.
- `resource_group` (String) Resource group UUID stored on the device.
- `type` (String) Device type.
- `uuid` (String) Device UUID assigned by VergeOS.
